BonsaiQR: a free QR code generator with a little nature

Turn a website link into a colorful, interactive bonsai tree. Choose your blossom color, reveal the QR code, and download it or share your bonsai with someone. Everything is created in your browser, with no account required.

How to create your bonsai QR code

  1. Enter your website address in the link field above.
  2. Choose a blossom color, or use the color picker to make your own.
  3. Tap the bonsai to reveal your QR code. Open the share menu to download the QR image or copy a link to your bonsai.

A few things to know

Is BonsaiQR free?

Yes. Create, customize, download, and share your bonsai QR code for free, without signing up.

What does the QR code open?

Scanning the QR code opens the website address you entered. Copy Link shares the interactive bonsai instead, so your recipient can enjoy the tree and choose to visit your website.

Will my downloaded QR code expire?

The downloaded QR image stores your destination directly and has no built-in expiration. It continues to work while that destination is available. Changing the destination here creates a new code; it does not update previously downloaded images.

How do I get the best scanning results?

Choose a color with good contrast, keep the clear space around the QR code, and test the downloaded image with your phone before printing or sharing it.

Is my website address private?

QR generation happens on your device. Anyone with your QR image or bonsai share link can read the destination, so avoid private access links or secrets. Read our privacy notice for details.
